scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run docs:smoke && npm run frontend:smoke && npm run provider:smoke && npm run startup:smoke && npm run smoke && npm audit
